"''Then I'll only have to tell you once to shut up and get busy.|The Sec-Tech and Avril Heert|}} A [[human]] '''individual''' worked as a security [[technician]] for the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. After the [[Medcenter|hospital]] was infiltrated by the [[human]] [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Kleya Marki]], the technician helped assist [[Supervisor]] [[Avril Heert]] and [[Aide|Attendant]] [[Joydali]] in locating where Marki was. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The Sec-Tech first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|''Andor ''Season 2]] episode "[[Who Else Knows?]]" released on [[May 13]], [[2025]] as part of the final block of episodes of [[Star Wars: Andor|the series]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} He was portrayed by [[Alexander Owen]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Lina Soh Hospital employees]] [[Category:Technicians]]
